Dream 2026-11-22 suggests a refinement: sharpen.

**What the vignettes add.** The existing problem is about private sources reaching published output; the vignettes name the control wanted. ddce04fb: 'we need to be able to have a way to strip types of records on export'. 53fd0e50: a 'cleaner process that will take an exported essay and remove records'. c26e0903: 'when we export an essay, we probably don't want to include the full source materials - just the key bits of text that we are building from'.

**Proposed.** When I export an essay, it carries the full source materials and working records it was built from, and I have no way to say which types of record stay out, so only the key cited fragments should reach the published file.

**Depth.** Three vignettes, 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-05; consistent. The cleaner-process one explicitly defers to later.

If you agree, the change is made by succession: a successor that supersedes this record, which stays as it is.
